description: No cross-game imports, no SoTE-flavored heritage chrs. Use for friends who only own base Nightreign without DLC, or to taste pure vanilla-only randomization. As of v0.23.72-late, heritage_pack.json functions as a real pool toggle — its 41 SoTE-dependent c-prefixes get dropped from the engine tag set + roster when disabled here. Previously this preset used engine_kwargs.excluded_prefixes as a workaround; that mechanism is no longer needed for the heritage case.
name: Vanilla NR only
